UPDATE - The audio issues should be fixed ! Check dev logs for more info

Warnings: Blood, Cannibalism, Patricide, Crude Language 

Bea is spending the summer with her dad, much to her dismay. One day she wakes up with a strange craving and a voice in her head.


Sweet Instincts is a short Visual Novel for the Spooktober 2026 Game Jam

  • Estimated playtime: 15-30 minutes
  • Original artwork and music
  • 1 ending (2 variations)


Art and Writing by 3005jin

Programming by vistaofchaos

Music by Dagan al

Kinetic Text by wattson

Optimized Shader for RenPy by Grimumu

Backgrounds from Pexels
